scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Defenses and budgets" depends on V0; Phase 2 "Depends on: V1, V2, the org-owner install approval."
scores.rationale: Phases go skeleton → defenses → retrieval → triage canary → fix loop → routing → public, with each gated by the validation it depends on.

scores.evidence: A team member opens the issue "Typo in README"... The agent applies `type:docs` and opens a draft PR from the forks org
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real production end-to-end slice across 9 tiers with deploy, rollback, and traces.

scores.evidence: Flip condition: "A comment class reaches ≥ 95% approval as written over 200 comments (ASSUMPTION) → that class may run on its own"
scores.rationale: Nine tradeoff rows give reversibility, default, assumption, validation and flip condition, and the R1 defaults are listed.

scores.evidence: Tasks, widest rework first: 1. Per-job scoped tokens (row 1). 2. A tool executor with an allow-list
scores.rationale: Within Phase 1, credential and executor work comes before leaf controls, and the plan states this ordering explicitly.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: "HMAC-verified webhooks; one-repo allow-list; issue text treated as data; kill switch"
scores.rationale: Every phase from 0 to 7 has concrete security controls.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: "One trace across every tier; ledger; alerts on dead-letter jobs and cost"
scores.rationale: Observability starts in Phase 0, and every later phase has specific dashboards, metrics or logs.

scores.evidence: Terraform; image signed and pinned by digest; model and prompt version stored on every job
scores.rationale: Reproducibility is addressed in every phase, covering infrastructure, images, index and eval versions, and agent version.

scores.evidence: Phase 0: "Idempotency keys; issue lock; dead-letter queue; rollback by digest"
scores.rationale: Each phase has concrete failure handling and rollback, from the first phase that builds anything.

scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Defenses and budgets" precedes Phase 2 retrieval/model access, Phase 4 memory/orchestration, Phase 6 routing/feedback
scores.rationale: Defenses, budgets and human-in-the-loop come first, followed by retrieval, model access, memory, orchestration, routing and feedback in the required order.

scores.evidence: Autonomous merging. Pull forward when stakeholders require it and at least 6 months of agent PRs show a revert rate below a threshold
scores.rationale: The deferred list is explicit, and most items carry a pull-forward condition.

note: Exceptionally thorough plan that meets every dimension with concrete content; the only weakness is that a few thresholds are left as assumptions or UNKNOWNs, and those are labeled as such.
